calls.video_title: 2008 Made Me a Millionaire. Pullbacks Like This Are Why
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated - he is building into ASML over the next few months (~10% of the basket). Only company in the world that builds EUV lithography machines; current machines all but sold out through 2027, customer down payments up ~180% in 9 months, operating margin broke out to ~44% last quarter after four years stuck in the 30s. P/E ~25 vs ~34 five-year average. Catches: much of last quarter's cash came from down payments that will not repeat at that pace, and China fell from ~36% to ~20% of sales on export controls.
calls.base_case: Irreplaceable monopoly with a sold-out order book; growth has accelerated four quarters in a row.
calls.bull_case: The order backlog converts into sustained margin expansion as EUV demand compounds.
calls.bear_case: Down-payment cash normalises and China restrictions tighten further, capping the re-rating.

calls.thesis: BUY first tracked (guest Joel Litman, Altimetry Research) — 'another buy idea': ASML is indispensable to cutting-edge chipmaking and has cemented its place in the AI value chain, with major customers also investors; the customer-investor model is smart integration, not circular financing.
calls.base_case: Without ASML there are no cutting-edge chips and no frontier AI models; its oligopoly position is secure.
calls.bull_case: Customer-investors lock in its place in the value chain.
calls.bear_case: A semiconductor cycle or AI build-out slowdown would hit equipment demand.

Stock Market Sell-Off: 5 Beaten-Down AI Stocks to Buy on the Dip
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 16 Nov, flipped from UNCERTAIN 19 Oct). Roughly fairly valued at $1,421 FV, but a rare chance to buy at fair value — it usually trades well above fair value like Costco. Was $2,000 (52-wk high) under 12 months ago. Supplier to Micron, TSMC, Intel, Samsung, SK Hynix; equipment at least a step ahead of competition.
calls.base_case: ASML keeps its lithography lead and trades back to its usual premium.
calls.bull_case: AI capex boom keeps order books full and the stock re-rates above fair value.
calls.bear_case: A chip-equipment downturn would hit orders despite the technology lead.

calls.video_title: Why Is ASML Stock Falling, and is it a Buying Opportunity?
calls.price_at_call: ~$1,420 (current price; DCF fair value garbled in captions, described as very close to $1,420)
calls.thesis: FLIP from UNCERTAIN (Oct 19). Upgraded ASML to a buying opportunity on 16 Nov 2026: excellent business now fairly valued after falling from a $2,000 52-week high to ~$1,420. Supply-constrained lithography leader, EPS expected to grow 33%/yr, orders out to 2030, pricing power, record 38.5% operating margin, forward P/E 22.5.
calls.base_case: EPS growth ~33%/yr for several years; revenue booming with orders out to 2030 and price increases rolling in through 2028.
calls.bull_case: Supply stays constrained and pricing power lifts margins further; manufacturing-facility buildout keeps demand ahead of supply.
calls.bear_case: A data-centre construction slowdown indirectly hits equipment demand; negative AI sentiment keeps multiples compressed.

calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY - among the four holdings closest to their buy-in triggers. He holds a large position (bought ~$722, trimmed 20% near $1,900) and calls ASML a true monopoly: all roads to high-end chips pass through it, with no real alternative.
calls.base_case: Trades toward ~$1,800 fair value; impenetrable moat.
calls.bull_case: China cannot replicate the throughput at scale; the monopoly premium holds.
calls.bear_case: Has given back gains from the ~$2,000 peak; growth uncertainty returns.

calls.price_at_call: Bought Thursday after ~9% drop; 3-yr forecast ~26%/yr; sales +55% last quarter
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked — bought on Thursday. Only maker of the machines that print the most advanced chips; cannot build enough to meet demand in 2027-28, so it sets prices.
calls.base_case: Chipmakers keep ordering more EUV machines than ASML can build.
calls.bull_case: Demand outruns supply for years; pricing power compounds.
calls.bear_case: Chip cycle turns; EUV order book shrinks.

calls.video_title: The Entire Market Relies On These Stocks
calls.thesis: HOLD reiterated: remaining fully invested and holding into Wednesday earnings despite 33x forward P/E and very high expectations (revenue +50-55%, EPS ~+89% expected); sees a true monopoly whose moat widens over the next decade, with installed-base management potentially tripling to $25-30B.
calls.bull_case: High-NA EUV lead widens; every chip still has to go through ASML's machines; supplier/customer/logistics moats deepen.
calls.bear_case: Expectations are extreme this quarter; a miss would hurt the stock badly and the market has sold ASML down incorrectly before.
